title: Practice 17: The present tense: the Е and И types

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: They say that garlic repels mosquitoes.
exercises.why: **отпугивать → отпугивает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: I have no details.
exercises.why: **располагать → располагаю** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: It looks like Tom is angry.
exercises.why: **сердиться → сердится** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Snowdrifts are formed because of the wind.
exercises.why: **образоваться → образуются** — present-type form, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: ___ (обитать) лишь Диего-Гарсия — самый крупный и южный из островов.
exercises.prompt: Only Diego Garcia, the largest and most southerly of the islands, is inhabited.
exercises.why: **обитать → Обитаем** — present tense, 1st person plural: ending -ем belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Мэри по Тому чуть не слюни ___ (пускать).
exercises.prompt: Mary is practically drooling over Tom.
exercises.why: **пускать → пускает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: У тебя есть бальзам для губ? У меня губы ___ (сохнуть).
exercises.prompt: Do you have some lip balm? My lips are dry.
exercises.why: **сохнуть → сохнут** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ут belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: She is always fishing for compliments.
exercises.why: **напрашиваться → напрашивается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: That's not allowed here.
exercises.why: **разрешаться → разрешается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: The equator divides the earth into two hemispheres.
exercises.why: **делить → делит** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.q: При таянии лёд ___ (превращаться) обратно в воду.
exercises.prompt: Ice turns back into water when it melts.
exercises.why: **превращаться → превращается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Only the first message is shown.
exercises.why: **отображаться → Отображается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: You've been kinda sad; what's bothering you?
exercises.why: **грустить → грустишь** — present tense, 2nd person singular: ending -ишь belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: This country is falling to pieces.
exercises.why: **разваливаться → разваливается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Когда белка чувствует опасность, первым делом она инстинктивно ___ (замирать) на месте.
exercises.prompt: When a squirrel senses danger, the first thing it instinctively does is stand still.
exercises.why: **замирать → замирает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: You're delusional. Go to bed!
exercises.why: **бредить → бредишь** — present tense, 2nd person singular: ending -ишь belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Cotton absorbs water.
exercises.why: **впитывать → впитывает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Flies lay eggs.
exercises.why: **откладывать → откладывают** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: In the summer, the retractable roof of the pool is opened.
exercises.why: **открывать → открывают** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Icicles hang from the roof of the house.
exercises.why: **свисать → свисают** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
